qualification: Literal accepted report statements bind all formula objects in SCOPE and all formulas in the public README. Equivalences m=d/2 and beta=p^floor(r/2) use the displayed definitions d=2m and h=floor(r/2).

report_statements.name: family
report_statements.verbatim: Let p be prime, c odd with 3<=c<p, d=2m even with 2<=d<p, r>=2, s>r, N=p^r, and n=cN+d.

report_statements.name: normalization
report_statements.verbatim:
e=v(p)=(p-1)p^(s-1), B=r(p-1)p^(r-1)/2,
    K=cN/2+cB, E=(c-1)N/2+cB, D=N+E-p,
    h=floor(r/2), beta=p^h, L=N/beta,
    rho=beta/2                         (r even),
    rho=p^(h-1)(2p-1)/2                (r odd),
    C_m=(2m-1)!!.

report_statements.name: new_coverage
report_statements.verbatim: The new coverage is ONLY odd 3<=c

report_statements.name: high_counts
report_statements.verbatim: Each disk has exactly cL high roots: (c-1)L boundary and L strict-interior roots. Their total is cN.

report_statements.name: zero
report_statements.verbatim: The L central interior roots include exactly one simple root X=0 and L-1 nonzero roots.

report_statements.name: shallow
report_statements.verbatim: Exactly d additional roots have v(X)=1/2.

report_statements.name: derivative_predecessor
report_statements.verbatim:
v(P_n')=D+m,       v(P_(n-1))=N+E+m-1     at every high root,
    v(P_n')=(n-1)/2,   v(P_(n-1))=(n-1)/2     at every shallow root.

report_statements.name: kernel
report_statements.verbatim:
N-p       at every high root,
    -2cB      at every shallow root.

report_statements.name: H_zero
report_statements.verbatim: Its exact z=-1 root is simple and corresponds to X=0.

report_statements.name: auxiliary_cancellation
report_statements.verbatim: Every such cancellation, of whatever subsequent depth, IMPROVES (4.2) and cannot affect the decisive unit C_m.

report_statements.name: smallest_endpoint
report_statements.verbatim: The smallest allowed new endpoint has p=5,c=3,d=4

report_statements.name: no_deeper_values
report_statements.verbatim: Their individual deeper valuations are not asserted.

root_counts.central_interior: one exact zero and L-1 nonzero roots
